prose: Author and movement artist Jason Quitt joins InnerVerse to discuss his mystical life experiences, recalling vivid lessons from dream teachers, the Egyptian Postures of Power, ideas for out-of-body lucidity, self-healing with breath and intention, and much more!
ext: Jason gives us an overview of the ancient Egyptian mapping of the layers of our bodies, funerary rites and life after death, the shadow and the Ib (heart), creation cosmologies, and a-ton of ancient ancestor knowledge!
music: InnerVerse intro theme by Conspiracy Music Guru
